errors.evidence: The chart's data range is from the year 2000 to 2021, not 2022. The last data point is one year after the 2020 tick mark.
The description claims the x-axis has uneven numerical labels, which is incorrect. The labels are placed at regular five-year intervals (2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020).
The green line for Österreich (Austria) starts at approximately 0.25 in the year 2000, not 0.4.
The blue line for Deutschland (Germany) starts at approximately 0.25 in the year 2000, not 0.3.
The peak for the green line around 2003-2004 is at approximately 0.6, not 0.7.

errors.evidence: The peak for the green line (Österreich) in 2015 is at approximately 1.3, not 1.45. The value 1.5 is the peak for the blue line (Deutschland).
The blue line for Germany shows a slight increase from 0.25 in 2000 to about 0.3 in 2002, not a decrease to 0.15.

The value for the blue line (Deutschland) in 2020 is approximately 0.3, not 0.2.
